# Scenario: docker login fails while apinfra-proxy is already running → nginx and
# prune are skipped (README docker_login_failed). Regression: previously nginx still
# ran ("running despite docker errors") and wrote vhosts for apps that never started.
#
# Cycle 1: deploy e2e-dskip-a → proxy + nginx conf live.
# Cycle 2: add e2e-dskip-b in Git + bad registry → login fails;
#          no nginx for B; A's conf unchanged; no "despite docker errors".

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: baseline with proxy'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra-proxy
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-dskip-a-web
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-dskip-a.conf
exec cp $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-dskip-a.conf $WORK/conf-a.before
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9961/
stdout 'DSKIP_A'

cd git-repo
cp ../settings.two.yml dev/settings.yml
mkdir -p dev/e2e-dskip-b
cp ../compose.b.yml dev/e2e-dskip-b/docker-compose.yml
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'chore: add second project requiring compose up'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.bad-registry .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'logging into registry 127.0.0.1:1'
stderr 'docker login 127.0.0.1:1'
stderr 'nginx processor: skipped \(docker login failed\)'
stderr 'pruning skipped \(docker login failed\)'
! stderr 'running despite docker errors'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/.events
grep 'docker_login_failed' $HOME/.events

# Compose for B may be on disk; pull/up and nginx must not have applied it.
exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-dskip-b/docker-compose.yml
! docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-dskip-b-web
! exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-dskip-b.conf

exec cmp $WORK/conf-a.before $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-dskip-a.conf
docker-assert-running apinfra-proxy
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-dskip-a-web
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9961/
stdout 'DSKIP_A'

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- .apinfra.bad-registry --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
containerRegistryHost=127.0.0.1:1
containerRegistryUser=bad
containerRegistryToken=bad
dockerLoginTimeout=5s

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-dskip-a
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9961
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.two.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-dskip-a
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9961
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none
  - name: e2e-dskip-b
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9962
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-dskip-a/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=DSKIP_A"]

-- compose.b.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=DSKIP_B"]

-- .env --
